## .claude/rules/cluster/applications/cloudevents-alertmanager.md

Directory scope: `cluster/applications/cloudevents-alertmanager/**`


* Stamp both `startsAt` and `endsAt` on every alert before POSTing it - an alert omitting `endsAt` inherits `global.resolve_timeout` from the server `cluster/manifests/mimir/overlays/dev/files/alertmanager.yaml` configures, which is one value shared by every source pushing into it, and Alertmanager derives a missing `startsAt` from `endsAt` rather than from the receipt time, so stamping only the latter dates the alert into the future; neither mistake fails the POST, the Sequence or `kustomize build`, and both surface only in what the slack receiver and `buildBody` in `cluster/applications/alerthandler/handler/critical_alert_handler.go` render
* Treat the hold as the delay between the anomaly stopping and the alert resolving, not as a margin to widen freely - Alertmanager rewrites `endsAt` on every push carrying the same label set, so a longer hold buys nothing while pushes keep arriving, and nothing in this pipeline ever pushes a resolved alert
